title: carex subtrigona
intro: Carex subtrigona, commonly known as Kukui, is a type of sedge plant native to Hawaii. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Carex subtrigona are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
